folds.heading: ## Dialogue draft bodies reconciled, 2026-11-04 (B68)
folds.body: All 84 item bodies in the seven dialogue draft lenses were reviewed; [original file/ordinal dispositions](../audits/reconciliation-2026-11-04/content-b68.json) retain the proposals. The existing scene, evidence, voice, interruption and consequence sections already supply their principal owners; draft “missing” assertions are not verified defects. Preserve meaningful knowledge, return, refusal, interruption and once-only settlement cases. Rumor timing follows the actual channel, including supported fast communication, not a universal walking-speed limit; rumor need not decay or mutate merely because time/world changed. A speaker may know a future event through real foreknowledge, genuinely refuse without an alternative, or retain silence/private beliefs. Public confidence/provenance is not an omniscient truth icon, trust meter, complete mind inspection or hidden-consequence preview. Repeated greetings/menu cycles can be intentional; test useful exit and unique settlement rather than banning graph cycles. No mandatory artificial reaction delay, vocabulary/line/branch quota, source-copying, translation toggle granting fluency or random AI speech follows. Useful internal provenance and original voice samples remain optional selected authoring checks under AD32/AD36.

folds.heading: ## DWF87–DWF94 body-review qualifications, 2026-11-04 (B68)
folds.body: The [character](audits/reconciliation-2026-11-04/content-b67.json) and [dialogue](audits/reconciliation-2026-11-04/content-b68.json) bodies now have actual ordinal dispositions, distinct from DWF82’s original title-only triage. DWF89’s travel shorthand means actual supported information-channel timing: a messenger, local testimony, instrument or supernatural communication can differ. No universal walking cap or compulsory rumor decay follows; repeated persuasion may have actual changed evidence, while identical unique settlement does not replay. DWF91 tests the selected identity/carrier/world and supported trait/title compatibility, not a universal mutuallyexclusive-trait list. DWF92’s canary checks its sentinel and inspected path; absence of that string cannot prove every secret stayed out of every prompt/output. DWF93’s voice swap is a useful sample, not a mandate that every short line uniquely identify a speaker. DWF87’s compression preserves durable promises, custody, identity and admitted knowledge; it does not erase long-play history or enforce forgetting. These remain scoped proposals/check opportunities under AD32/AD36, not implemented validators or new gameplay gates.

folds.heading: ## Dialogue bodies reviewed, 2026-11-04 (B68)
folds.body: B68 freshly read all seven dialogue files, 84 item bodies, and folded their useful scene/knowledge/return/settlement distinctions into the dialogue owner. [Ordinal dispositions](../reconciliation-2026-11-04/content-b68.json) distinguish proposals from draft absence assertions and preserve intentional cycles, actual fast communication, refusal, voice and knowledge limits. Character plus dialogue body coverage is now 14 files/168 items. The seven world files remain unread at body level in this continuous pass; title triage does not supply them (AD32).
